content: The clitoral glans, also known as the glans clitoridis, is the external portion of the clitoris. It is covered by the clitoral hood, which is an external structure that is connected to the labia minora. The clitoral glans is also attached to the frenulum clitoridis, a structure that is similarly connected to the labia minora. Additionally, the clitoral glans is connected to the clitoral body, which is an internal structure. Images that may provide further understanding include depictions of the external anatomy of the clitoris and the stages of development of external sexual organs in both males and females.
